rationale: The Court will hold that an interlocutory dismissal later deemed erroneous cannot “cure” a removal defect because Rule 54(b) revisability and merger mean the party-posture change was never legally durable, so allowing final-judgment diversity to suffice would bootstrap jurisdiction. Applying §§ 1332 and 1441–1447 and § 1447(c)’s mandatory remand command, the proper disposition is vacatur of the federal judgment and remand.
